changes: Explicit board factory: same boot/time source, board-private POSIX kernel writer lock, shared local Store/ProfileAccess, summary budget derived from real persona.

Existing worker before_step refreshes pinned Date health every ten minutes with one-second original deadline, foreground cancellation and bounded retry backoff; idle/clock guards never perform network IO.
Board ASR, local preloaded FFT frontend leases, bounded raw PCM producer queue, existing one capture/echo/barge/player owners. No Windows ASR/frontend business calls.

Original face enrollment FSM and 90-second guide stream bounded by the original turn deadline, same playback owner, immediate per-cue PCM, combined final hash/sample receipt. Source/grant revocation stops further cues and successful completion.
Local authenticated profile list/create/select/revoke is connected to the real GTK dialog and same-process grants; no Windows grant file fallback in board mode.
Profile recent dialogue is partitioned by conversation source; long-term facts/history remain profile-scoped.
Board speaker route and exact original face receipt bridge compose with the same guide; original three-sample voice enrollment tested through actual jobs/TTS/player receipt with a fake encoder.
Visual worker and query policy are wired to one configured device scope. SourcedBoardReply validates same-scope dependencies; normalized device queries are device_event, never fabricated user_said.

Fresh r3 GTK/profile selector candidate generated only against independently hashed original snapshot. Existing owner-thread cleanup precedes bundle shutdown. Local rendering is a required gate; no character substitution or frame-rate downgrade.

config_contract.production_requires: data_origin=board; local render readiness; same-process speaker business attached; fresh face-gallery source pin; serial real-data migration/handoff performed by root.
config_contract.operator_control: Existing board-local private credential configuration. GTK masks credential, requires explicit click/create consent, never prints or persists the input.
config_contract.approved_feedback: Version1 local assets manifest with thinking cue mandatory, optional arrival/invitation, each entry path plus original voice_wire metadata; verified SHA/native 24k mono16/<=5sec.

remaining_gates: Root actual board combined frontend throughput/ASR/speaker performance evidence overrides synthetic tests. Do not deploy while that gate fails.
Actual ARM current clock/Date and natural five-minute source retention tests are root-owned.
Current production remote16 render cannot silently become local8. Local render at required performance and separate user character decision remain necessary.
Fresh actual face gallery /proc+boot+source/model pins and all-board camera feature backend verification; preserve original failed cross-machine authorization boundary.

Real consistent snapshots for existing conversation/speaker/anonymous/link/observation data, original key and namespace preservation, stop old writer before exact single-writer activation; this subtask performed no real migration.
Original WebRTC dependency and approved same ECAPA export on ARM; no quality substitute.
Physical microphone, playback/listening, interruption acoustics and final human selection acceptance remain untested here.
